nodes.label: Spectral Bond Engine (Sturm-Liouville Decomposition)
nodes.rationale: One-factor interest rate models cast into self-adjoint Sturm-Liouville form. Bond prices as infinite sums of eigenfunctions. 10x-100x faster convergence for sensitivity calculations vs Monte Carlo (SSRN-5047749).

nodes.label: Q-World Integration (P-world/Q-world Bridge)
nodes.rationale: CIR/Heston models for fair-value yield of 3M T-Bill. Risk-Premium Residual Monitor compares P-world observed spread vs Q-world fair value. Validates DISLOCATED status from ProxyDivergenceGuard (SSRN-1717163).

nodes.label: MarketSensitivityLibrary (Standardized Greeks)
nodes.rationale: Formalize all risk sensitivities into standardized Greeks nomenclature: Repo-Delta, Rate-Delta, Rate-Gamma, Spread-Delta, Volga. Sensitivity-adjusted signal logic.

nodes.label: CVA/FVA Valuation Adjustments
nodes.rationale: Credit Valuation Adjustment, Debt Valuation Adjustment, Funding Valuation Adjustment. VirtualPortfolio reports Adjusted NAV reflecting all three adjustments (SSRN-2396545).
